import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data: np.ndarray) -> plt.Axes:
    arr = np.asarray(data)

    if arr.dtype.kind not in "iuf":
        raise TypeError("Input array must contain numeric real values.")

    if np.any(np.isnan(arr)):
        raise ValueError("Input array contains NaNs.")
    if np.any(arr < 0):
        raise ValueError("Input array contains negative numbers.")

    values = np.sort(arr.ravel())
    n = values.size
    x = np.arange(n)

    total = values.sum(dtype=float)
    if n == 0 or total == 0:
        cumulative_prob = np.zeros(n, dtype=float)
    else:
        cumulative_prob = np.cumsum(values, dtype=float) / float(total)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(x, cumulative_prob, marker="o", linestyle="-")
    ax.set_title("Cumulative Probability Plot")
    ax.set_xlabel("Index")
    ax.set_ylabel("Cumulative Probability")

    return ax
